operational_risks.title: Startup-only configuration loading may require restart on rotation
operational_risks.description: Framework configuration appears startup-loaded and may not refresh secrets at runtime.
operational_risks.migration_impact: Rotation may require restart or pool refresh.
operational_risks.recommended_action: Test restart and rotation behavior before production rollout.

rationale: Kubernetes manifests and Spring configuration require coordinated changes.
Database credential rotation depends on pooling behavior.

suggested_migration_sequence.rationale: Preserve existing application keys before changing runtime-sensitive dependencies.
Move static API keys before datasource or certificate flows.
Remove long-lived deployment secrets from pipeline secret stores.
Datasource rotation has higher runtime risk and should follow lower-risk validation.
